facts.text: Forestville’s name means “town in the forest,” a nod to the woodlands that surrounded the settlement when it was founded.
The town sits near Ohio’s only Revolutionary War fort, Fort Laurens, a historic landmark that tells the story of the state’s frontier days.
The area’s history is preserved in local museums that showcase early Ohio life and the region’s role in the nation’s westward expansion.
Forestville’s community events often celebrate the town’s heritage, drawing visitors to reenactments and historical tours.
The town’s modest size belies a rich cultural scene, with occasional live performances that reflect the region’s artistic spirit.
